notices.title: Extended Metro Timings During IPL Matches at Chinnaswamy Stadium
notices.summary: Last train departures from all terminal stations (Challaghatta, Whitefield, Nagasandra, Silk Institute) extended up to 11:30 PM on match days.

notices.title: 5% Discount on WhatsApp & Namma Metro App QR Tickets
notices.summary: Commuters purchasing single journey QR tickets via WhatsApp (+91 81055 56677) or Namma Metro App enjoy a flat 5% discount on standard token fares.

notices.title: National Common Mobility Card (NCMC) Accepted Across All Turnstiles
notices.summary: Any RuPay NCMC prepaid card issued by SBI, Canara Bank, HDFC, or ICICI can be tapped at automatic fare collection (AFC) gates across BMRCL network.

notices.title: Baggage Weight & Dimension Guidelines inside Namma Metro
notices.summary: Maximum allowed baggage per passenger is 15 kg. Oversized luggage exceeding 60cm x 45cm x 25cm requires special clearance at security scanners.
